items.prompt: Explore the application and discover user journeys.

proposed.name: Navigate core blockchain dashboard sections (Chain, Wallets, Mining) and verify each renders
proposed.description: Exercise the app's primary blockchain UI by navigating from the dashboard through the three core CHAIN-section tabs — Chain, Wallets, and Mining — verifying that each section switch produces meaningful blockchain-related content (block list, wallet list, mining status) rather than a blank or broken page. This corresponds to the design doc's requirement that the dashboard at / shows the blockchain UI and that chain, wallet, and mining endpoints are exercised.

proposed.name: Memorize a text and reconstruct + sign a block — the core blockchain mining workflow
proposed.description: The dashboard's primary workflow (explicitly prompted by 'Aucun bloc miné — mémorisez un graphe puis signez') is to memorize a text via the Quick start 'Memorize a text' → Go action, then reconstruct and sign a block via the 'Reconstruct + sign block' → Go action. This journey exercises that end-to-end flow — the app's core IR-learn and block-signing functionality corresponding to /api/v1/ir/learn and the chain/block-creation endpoints — and verifies that each step produces meaningful content (an IR learning form/confirmation and a block reconstruction/signing result) rather than a blank or broken page.

proposed.name: View P2P network peers, system logs, and debug console — blockchain infrastructure monitoring
proposed.description: Navigate from the dashboard through the SYSTEM-section tabs — P2P Network (S14), Logs (S11), and Console (S12) — verifying that each section renders meaningful blockchain infrastructure content: a peer list / network status view (corresponding to /api/v1/p2p/status and /api/v1/p2p/peers), live demo logs (corresponding to /api/v1/dashboard/logs/demo-live), and an interactive debug console. This exercises the core infrastructure monitoring surfaces of the ARTCB blockchain dashboard that no existing journey covers.

proposed.name: Create a new wallet and verify it appears in the wallet list — the blockchain wallet generation flow
proposed.description: Navigate to the Wallets section and exercise the wallet creation form — fill the wallet name field and click Generate — then verify the new wallet appears in the wallet list and can be selected. This covers the design doc's /api/v1/wallet/create and /api/v1/wallet/list functionality, a core blockchain surface no existing journey exercises. The wallet creation form fields (S33 name input and S34 Generate button) are the primary wallet management workflow of the ARTCB dashboard.

proposed.name: Fill the Memorize IR-learning form end-to-end — session, LLM toggle, distributed calc toggle, source text, and submit
proposed.description: Navigate to the Memorize page and fully exercise the IR-learning data-entry form: fill the session_id field, toggle the use_llm checkbox, toggle the distributed calculation (pool E2E) checkbox, load a sample source via the Charger Wailly button (or type source text), then click Memorize to submit. Verify that the form submits and the Proof-of-Learning / graph-building panel shows progress or a result rather than staying idle. This covers the design doc's /api/v1/ir/learn endpoint — the core IR learning workflow — with every form field exercised, which no existing journey does (journey 2 only describes the combined quick-start navigation, not the full form). The form fields (S26 session, S27 use_llm, S28 distributed calc, S30 source text, S31 Memorize, S32 Charger Wailly) are all now visible and testable.

proposed.name: Configure an AI provider integration end-to-end — select provider, fill name, model, and API key, then connect
proposed.description: Navigate to the Integrations section (S13) and fully exercise the AI provider configuration form: select a provider from the dropdown (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or OpenRouter), fill the integration name field, fill the model field, fill the API key field, then click Connect. Verify that the form submits and produces a connection confirmation or status change rather than staying idle. This covers the ARTCB dashboard's AI integration configuration — a core surface that feeds the IR-learning and Proof-of-Learning workflows — with every form field exercised. No existing journey covers the Integrations page or its configuration form (S41–S45).

This covers the design doc's /api/v1/wallet/create and /api/v1/wallet/list functionality, a core blockchain surface no existing journey exercises. The wallet creation form fields (S33 name input and S34 Generate button) are the primary wallet management workflow of the ARTCB dashboard.

existingJourneys.name: Fill the Memorize IR-learning form end-to-end — session, LLM toggle, distributed calc toggle, source text, and submit
existingJourneys.description: Navigate to the Memorize page and fully exercise the IR-learning data-entry form: fill the session_id field, toggle the use_llm checkbox, toggle the distributed calculation (pool E2E) checkbox, load a sample source via the Charger Wailly button (or type source text), then click Memorize to submit. Verify that the form submits and the Proof-of-Learning / graph-building panel shows progress or a result rather than staying idle. The form fields (S26 session, S27 use_llm, S28 distributed calc, S30 source text, S31 Memorize, S32 Charger Wailly) are all now visible and testable.

existingJourneys.name: Configure an AI provider integration end-to-end — select provider, fill name, model, and API key, then connect
existingJourneys.description: Navigate to the Integrations section (S13) and fully exercise the AI provider configuration form: select a provider from the dropdown (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or OpenRouter), fill the integration name field, fill the model field, fill the API key field, then click Connect. Verify that the form submits and produces a connection confirmation or status change rather than staying idle. This covers the ARTCB dashboard's AI integration configuration — a core surface that feeds the IR-learning and Proof-of-Learning workflows — with every form field exercised. No existing journey covers the Integrations page or its configuration form (S41–S45).

existingJourneys.name: Create a blockchain group and join it — the group formation and wallet-binding workflow
existingJourneys.description: Navigate to the Groups section (S16) and fully exercise the group creation form: fill the group name field, fill any configuration fields (version, etc.), select an active wallet, click Create, then click Join to join the group. Verify that the group is created and that joining produces a confirmation or membership status change. This covers the ARTCB dashboard's group governance workflow — a core blockchain community/consensus surface with a multi-field form (S53–S60) that no existing journey exercises. It corresponds to the design doc's requirement that all blockchain core surfaces be tested.

existingJourneys.name: Add a P2P network peer and synchronize all peers — blockchain network management workflow
existingJourneys.description: Navigate to the P2P Network section (S14) and exercise the peer management workflow: fill the peer connection detail fields (S47, S48, S49 — fields with no visible label or placeholder identifying them, so the user cannot tell what each box expects), click Ajouter (S50) to add the peer, then click Synchroniser tous les pairs (S46) to sync the full peer list. existingJourneys.name: Create a governance proposal — select voting wallet, fill title/description/version, and submit
existingJourneys.description: Navigate to the Governance section and fully exercise the governance proposal creation form: select a voting wallet (S52), fill the title field (S53, which has no visible label or placeholder identifying it, so the user cannot tell what the box expects), fill the description field (S54, also unlabeled/unplaceholdered), fill the version field (S55), then click Créer (S56) to submit the proposal. Verify that the proposal is created and the app gives feedback — a confirmation, the new proposal appearing in the Propositions list, or a status change — rather than nothing happening. existingJourneys.name: Create an AI Memory memo and engrave it in the blockchain — the AI-observation-to-on-chain-commit workflow
existingJourneys.description: Navigate to the AI Memory section and exercise the full memo creation pipeline: click New memo, select a memo type (observation/bugfix/lesson/decision/hypothesis/goal/proof), fill the label field, click + Ajouter to add the memo, then click 'Graver dans la blockchain' to commit the memo on-chain. Verify that the memo is created with feedback and that the engrave action produces a confirmation or on-chain commit status. This covers the core ARTCB Proof-of-Learning workflow where AI agent observations and decisions are recorded as memos and then committed to the blockchain — a primary function of the AI Memory section (S70, S84, S77, S78, S86) that no existing journey exercises. Journey 12 only fills the AI contributor registration form; this journey covers the memo creation and blockchain engraving workflow, which is the section's primary on-chain functionality.

proposed.name: Add an AI Memory webhook endpoint — fill URL and label, submit, and verify the webhook is registered
proposed.description: Navigate to the AI Memory section, click the Webhooks tab (S73), and fully exercise the webhook creation form that was revealed: fill the webhook URL field (S76, placeholder 'URL HTTPS (https://...)') and the label field (S77, placeholder 'Label'), then click '+ Ajouter' (S78) to submit. Verify that adding the webhook produces feedback — a confirmation message, the new webhook appearing in an active webhooks list, or a status change — rather than nothing happening. Journey 17 navigates to the Webhooks tab and describes viewing webhook management content, but the actual webhook creation form (S76–S78) has never been filled and submitted. This is a data-entry form whose primary purpose is to register an HTTPS endpoint that external AI tools (Cursor, ChatGPT, LangChain) receive live blockchain memory updates at — a core integration surface of the ARTCB AI Memory backend. The form-coverage rule requires exercising it rather than leaving it as a visited-but-unfilled page.
